segments.en: Today I practise computer English in a real conversation. I need to explain a small task clearly to another person. I say "performance" when I talk about my computer project. I say "latency" when I talk about my computer project. I say "cache" when I talk about my computer project. I tell my teammate: Today I use performance, latency, and cache. At the end, I say: I can use performance clearly today.

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“计算机英语”，场景是“性能、延迟与缓存”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。performance：性能，系统完成工作的速度和效率。示例：I learned how to use "performance" in a computer task.latency：延迟，从发出请求到收到响应的等待时间。示例：I learned how to use "latency" in a computer task.cache：缓存，为快速读取而暂时保存的数据。示例：I learned how to use "cache" in a computer task.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“日常交流英语”，场景是“比较并作出决定”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。What are the main differences?：主要区别是什么？。示例：What are the main differences?This one is more reliable.：这个更可靠。。示例：This one is more reliable.The other option is cheaper.：另一个方案更便宜。。示例：The other option is cheaper.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“GitHub 项目英语”，场景是“专业代码评审用语”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。Looks good to me.：我看起来没问题。。示例：Our team uses "Looks good to me." to keep the project clear.Could you clarify this part?：你可以说明这一部分吗？。示例：Our team uses "Could you clarify this part?" to keep the project clear.Please add a test.：请增加一个测试。。示例：Our team uses "Please add a test." to keep the project clear.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。
